text:
elin: Heads-up 1st pass on Cedar9B-int4 is in. Unit economics look attractive but we have a reproducible quality delta on multi-paragraph summaries and citation-heavy Q&A. Need a concise cost-vs-quality brief and a deployment guardrail proposal for GTN.

rafa: Microbench summary from infra: 195 tok/s/GPU sustained, p50 120ms, p95 480ms at 1k context. Estimated unit cost: 0.32x vs our baseline 13b-int8. Cost per 1M tokens ~ $22 (int4) vs $68 baseline.

elin: Eval highlights (eval harness, 40k mixed samples):
- conversational customer help: accept-rate -0.6%
- multi-paragraph summarization: surrogate-score -3.2 / human flags 3.2%
- citation Q&A (sources present): exact-match -1.1% / wrong-source rate +1.9%

tess: Observed runtime oddity: quantized attention introduces subtle drift in key/value representations after ~800 tokens -> increases re-generation probability for long outputs. This aligns with the longform drop. KV retention tuning reduces it but doesn't eliminate.

morgan: For product we should give plain language guidance: is this safe for primary rollout for FAQ/chat but risky for long reports and citation-sensitive features?

rafa: Econ bullet points (rounded):
- Unit cost multiplier: 0.32x baseline
- Annualized saving example: 50k DAU * 800 tokens/day * (1-0.32) -> ~27.2M tokens/day saved -> ~$600k/yr at current L0 rates (rough).
- Tradeoff: expected increase in human-review volume for longform slices and citation checks.

elin: Compact slice scorecard:
```
Model: Cedar9B-int4
Slices: convo-chat | multi-paragraph-summary | citation-qa
Quality delta vs baseline: -0.6% | -3.2% | -1.1%
Latency (p95 1k ctx): 480ms | 620ms (kv drift tail) | 500ms
Unit-cost: 0.32x baseline
Product-risk: Low | Medium | Medium
```

morgan: Product asked for expected flag counts if we route 40% of traffic. Assume multi-paragraph is 6% of traffic. What's the absolute bump?

elin: Calc: extra flags = routing_pct * flag_rate * slice_share = 0.4 * 0.032 * 0.06 = 0.000768 -> 0.0768% absolute increase in overall requests. That's ~0.8 extra flags per 1k requests. We'll surface both per-1k and per-day estimates for GTN.

tess: Mitigations we can ship quickly:
- KV retention tuning for long-turn hosts
- Soft-limiter to cap generation length for high-risk slices
- On-device quick rerank: if reranker score falls below 0.65, fallback to baseline

morgan: Proposed rollout and guardrails for GTN:
1) Start canary at 3% total traffic for convo-chat and FAQ slices only.
2) Shadow 25% of multi-paragraph-summary traffic for 72h with priority human labels.
3) If human-flag rate for summary slice <= 2% AND source-check failures < 1.5%, step to 20% shadow + open 10% live for low-risk slices.
4) Maintain a 5% holdback reserve for citation-qa until re-ranker thresholds are tuned.
5) Automatic fallback: requests with rerank_score < 0.65 or kv-drift-detect true -> route to baseline.

rafa: Suggested config snippet for rollout (for ops):
```
canary:
  percent: 3
  allowed_slices: [convo-chat, faq]
shadow:
  percent: 25
  slice: multi-paragraph-summary
fallback_policy:
  rerank_threshold: 0.65
  fallback_model: baseline-13b-int8
monitoring:
  summary_flag_alert: 2%_1h
  citation_fail_alert: 1.5%_4h
```

morgan: My one-line recommendation for GTN: "Cedar9B-int4 offers ~68% per-token cost savings with acceptable regressions for short chat/FAQ; hold back multi-paragraph summaries and citation-sensitive QA behind shadowing and reranking until targeted tuning reduces flags below 2%."

elin: Short risk table for PMs:
- Cost upside: High (~0.32x unit cost)
- Short-chat/FAQ: Minimal regression
- Long summaries: Noticeable regressions (3.2% flags) -> require holdback/shadowing
- Citation QA: Moderate regressions -> require reranker + holdback
- Ops burden: Moderate (monitoring, KV tuning, reranker thresholds)

tess: I'll open a quick TODO list: KV tuning PR, reranker threshold sweep, create shadow observers, add slice-alerts.

ops-bot: Shadow observers deployed in cluster: shadow-cedar9b-2026-03-23. Runbook: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/cedar9b-shadow

morgan: Can someone make a one-slide cheatsheet (scorecard + recommended rollout) for GTN comms? If so we'll sync with PMs tomorrow.
elin: I'll draft the slide and include per-1k and per-day flag estimates. Ping me if you want the raw eval CSV. :+1:
